description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to support the Federal Republic of Somalia to acquire and deploy COVID-19 vaccines, strengthen national immunization capacity, and support the continuity of essential health care services

The development objective of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) Emergency Vaccination Project for Somalia is to support the Federal Republic of Somalia to acquire and deploy Project COVID-19 vaccines and to strengthen national immunization capacity. The project comprises of two components. The first component, vaccine deployment and acquisition objective is to support the deployment of the Covid vaccine access (COVAX) acquired vaccines to cover about 20 percent of the target population and other Project COVID-19 vaccines which meet World Bank financing criteria to cover up to an additional 10 percent of the target population. It consists of following sub-components: (i) transportation, supply chain, and logistics capacity strengthening; (ii) social mobilization efforts; (iii) acquisition of additional project COVID-19 vaccines; and (iv) health care waste management. The second component, implementation management will support the national COVID-19 vaccination program by strengthening planning and implementation capacity at different levels (example, national, and federal member state). It consists of following sub-components: (i) program management support; (ii) supervision, coordination, human resources management, and training; and (iii) implementation support.

condition.narrative: Section I. B. 1(d) of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreementselect and hire, by no later than six (6) months after the EffectiveDate, and thereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Project, the services of a monitoring and supervisionconsulting firm with qualifications and experience and under terms of reference acceptable to the Association.

Section I. D. 5 of Schedule 2 to the Financing AgreementThe Recipient shall, and shall cause the FMSs/BRA, and the UN Agencies to,establish within two (2) months after the Effective Date, publicize, maintain and operate an accessible grievance mechanism, toreceive and facilitate resolution of concerns and grievances of Project-affected people, and take all measures necessary andappropriate to resolve, or facilitate the resolution of, such concerns and grievances, in a manner acceptable to the Association.

Section I.A.1 of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS to enter into subsidiary agreements with each participating FMSs/BRA tofacilitate the carrying out of Project activities in the FMSs/BRA under components 1.2, 1.4 and 2.2. of the Project.

Section I.B.1 (a) through (c) of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS to maintain throughout the period of implementation ofthe project: (a) the Project Steering Committee (PSC); (b) the Project Coordination and Implementation Unit (PCIU); and (c) theESFSUnit.

Section I.B.1(d) of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS to select and hire, by no later than six (6) months after theEffective Date and thereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Project, the services of a monitoring andsupervision consulting firm, in order to monitor, asses and report on: (a) the Project's compliance with VAC, the POM andinternational and good practices on protection of personal data: (b) the UN Agencies performance under their respective outputagreements; (c) the effectiveness and impact of health workers training and the public information/awareness campaigns/outreachactivities; and (d) the accessibility and responsiveness of the various grievance redress mechanisms.

Section I.C.1 of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS to prepare and adopt a Project Operations Manual (POM), in a manner andsubstance satisfactory to the Association and thereafter implement the Project and cause the FMSs/BRA and the UN Agencies to carryout their respective responsibilities under the Project, in accordance therewith.
Section I.D. of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:All Project COVID-19 Vaccines to be purchased/procured under the Projectshall satisfy the (Association's) Vaccine Approval Criteria (VAC).

Section I.E.1 of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS to enter into, by not later than 45 days after the Effective Date, andthereafter maintain throughout the period of Project implementation, and output agreement with WHO, under terms and conditionsapproved by the Association, for purposes of carrying out Sub-Component 2.1 of the Project.

Section I.E.2 of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement: FGS to enter into, by not later than 45 days after the Effective Date, andthereafter maintain throughout the period of Project implementation, and output agreement with UNICEF, under terms and conditionsapproved by the Association, for purposes of carrying out Sub-Components 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 and 1.4 of the Project.

Section I.F.1 of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS to, by no later than October 31 of each year, throughout the period ofimplementation, prepare and furnish to the Association an annual work plan and budget containing all activities proposed to becarried out under the Project during the following fiscal year, as well as the proposed financing plan for the expendituresrequired thereunder, indicating the envisioned amounts and source of financing, all in accordance with the POM.

Section I.H. 2 of Schedule 2 to the Financing AgreementThe FGS and the FMSs/BRA shall ensure that the ownership of any assetsgenerated, goods procured, and works constructed by the FGs and the FMSs/BRA's security or armed forces, out of the financingprocess shall be transferred to, or shall vest with, the MOH or any other appropriate line ministry or agency agree with theAssociation.

Section I.H.1 of Schedule 2 to the Financing AgreementAll activities carried out by security consultants/consulting firms and/orthe FGS or the FMSs/BRA's security or armed force s under the Project shall be under the control of the Ministry of Health (MoH)and/or the UN Agencies, as the case may be, and shall be undertaken exclusively for the purposes related to the Project. All goods,works, services, incremental operating costs, and training financed by the IDA Grant may be used by the security or armed forces,or paid to the security consultants/consulting firms, under the direction and control of either the MoH or the UN Agencies, andstrictly in accordance with the POM and/or other arrangements or protocols that the Association may require d for carrying outthese activities.

Sections I.E.1 & 2 of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement:FGS ensure, and cause the FMS/BRA and the UN Agencies to ensure, thatthe Project is: (a) carried out in accordance with the ESSs, in a manner acceptable to the Association and (b) implemented inaccordance with the ESCP, in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Association.
